scripts.restore-git: while IFS= read -r line; do name=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f1); value=$(echo "$line" | cut -d' ' -f2-); git config --global "$name" "$value"; done < ./git/aliases.txt
scripts.restore-rectangle: killall Rectangle 2>/dev/null || true && defaults import com.knollsoft.Rectangle ./rectangle/com.knollsoft.Rectangle.plist && open -a Rectangle
scripts.restore-all: npm run restore-git && npm run restore-vscode && npm run restore-obsidian && npm run restore-claude && npm run restore-rectangle
scripts.save-all: npm run save-git && npm run save-vscode && npm run save-obsidian && npm run save-claude && npm run save-rectangle
